execution_modes.prefreeze: mode + wrapper SHA256 are immutable pre-scoring fields; no scientific threshold changes

independence: confirmed unseen accession/parent/sequence + source and sequence-group review; family/parent/source/match-group connected components share leakage_unit; ledger absence is insufficient
matched_controls: match_group must contain an ART-positive and independently defined hard-neighbor/certified-negative for primary_art
method_ranking: verbatim frozen algorithms; all surviving candidates retained; no top-K censoring
no_functional_claim: sequence localization is not wet-lab validation
positive_art_component_coordinates: array and RT intervals required for every independently curated target and must lie within author system interval
secondary_rt_interpretation: General structured RNA need not contain RT; RT non-recovery is not evidence of poor ART detection or Arm M superiority
secondary_truth_basis: other_structured_rna uses INDEPENDENT_AUTHOR_ANNOTATION, author_defined_rna_interval, SECONDARY_ONLY; no new-blind ART inference
truth_targets: one target_id per independently curated target; whole native FASTA supplied once per sample
